customers_email_idx.name: customers_email_idx
customers_email_idx.where: deleted_at is null and email is not null

prices_per_unit_shape.name: prices_per_unit_shape
prices_per_unit_shape.value: billing_scheme <> 'per_unit' or (unit_amount is not null and tiers is null and tiers_mode is null)

prices_tiered_shape.name: prices_tiered_shape
prices_tiered_shape.value: billing_scheme <> 'tiered' or (tiers is not null and tiers_mode is not null and unit_amount is null)

prices_recurring_shape.name: prices_recurring_shape
prices_recurring_shape.value: type <> 'recurring' or (recurring_interval is not null and recurring_interval_count is not null and usage_type is not null)

prices_one_time_shape.name: prices_one_time_shape
prices_one_time_shape.value: type <> 'one_time' or (recurring_interval is null and recurring_interval_count is null and usage_type is null)
